# Who is leaving your Patreon, and what is it costing you?

> Free analyzer for Patreon creators: drop in your Members export CSV and see active, declined and former patrons, MRR by tier, churn by tenure cohort, at-risk declined payments, concentration and the fee take. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
